title: Library
subtitle: Your books
empty_body: Create your first book to start writing.
conceiving_hint: The conception agent is drafting the setting materials. Open the studio to continue.
delete_body: The book, its chapters and all its canon rows are deleted, and any open agent session is stopped first. This cannot be undone.
new_book_description: A title and a writing language are enough to start. Setting materials can be written by hand.
new_book_conception_description: A knowledge check runs first. Then the conception agent asks a few questions, drafts the setting materials and research topics, and hands the book over on Finalize.
auto_start_conception: Start conception automatically when the research before it finishes
